title: Anthropic release Claude Opus 5, its 'safest model yet'
excerpt: Most of the intelligence of Fable, at half the price.
content_html:
Anthropic has unveiled a new AI model it says comes close to Claude Fable 5 in its levels of intelligence — at half the price.

Claude Opus 5 was just released by Anthropic on Friday. The AI company is already pushing the model out as the default model on Claude Max, Anthropic's highest subscription plan which starts at $100 a month. It's also the strongest available model on Claude Pro, the company's $20-per-month subscription tier.

Claude Opus 5 tops Anthropic's other models in key areas

Opus 5 is "designed to be used every day," Anthropic says, adding that it's more efficient than the company's previous models.

You May Also Like

Most notably, the company calls Opus 5 its "most aligned model to date." This means Opus 5 abides by "human values" and safety guidelines.

When compared to prior models like Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, or Fable 5, Opus 5 has the lowest rates of deceptiveness and is the least likely to be tricked into misuse, Anthropic says of its "safest model yet."

Mashable Light Speed

One intriguing test highlighted by Anthropic: how fast Opus 5 solves a problem that the model has never seen before. The company says it's three times as fast as the next-best model, and scored nearly four times higher than OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol.

Claude Opus 5 benchmarks

Credit: Anthropic

Compared to Fable 5, Opus 5 performs better or the same in the vast majority of Anthropic benchmark tests. (Notable exceptions: health and legal benchmarks). It beats OpenAI's GPT 5.6 Sol in every benchmark except for Agentic coding.

Anthropic is especially proud of Opus 5's science benchmarks, calling the model the "most capable generally available model for scientific research." Still, Mythos 5 beats Opus 5 in areas such as biology research.

Cybersecurity is another area where Opus 5 falls behind, and that's by design. Anthropic says it purposefully left such tasks out of Opus 5's training. The model can still find vulnerabilities as it expands its dataset, but is much worse at exploiting them than Mythos and previous models.

The choice is a notable one in the wake of an OpenAI agent recently going rogue and hacking a client's server. Opus 5 was clearly trained by Anthropic with safeguards in mind.

How to try Claude Opus 5

Claude Opus 5 is available as of Friday July 24, across Anthropic's platforms.

Opus 5 is now the default AI model on Claude Max and the strongest available model on Claude Pro. The model costs $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, which is equivalent to Opus 4.8's pricing.

content_html_zh:
Anthropic 推出了一种新的人工智能模型，据称其智能水平接近《克劳德寓言 5》——而价格却只有一半。

Anthropic 于周五刚刚发布了 Claude Opus 5。 这家 AI 公司已经将该模型推出为 Claude Max 的默认模型，Claude Max 是 Anthropic 的最高订阅计划，起价为每月 100 美元。 它也是 Claude Pro 上最强大的可用型号，Claude Pro 是该公司每月 20 美元的订阅套餐。

Claude Opus 5 在关键领域领先 Anthropic 的其他型号

Anthropic 表示，Opus 5“专为日常使用而设计”，并补充说它比该公司之前的型号更高效。

你可能也喜欢

最值得注意的是，该公司称 Opus 5 为“迄今为止最一致的型号”。 这意味着 Opus 5 遵守“人类价值观”和安全准则。

Anthropic 在谈到其“迄今为止最安全的模型”时表示，与 Opus 4.8、Sonnet 5 或 Fable 5 等之前的模型相比，Opus 5 的欺骗率最低，并且最不可能被欺骗而被误用。

可混搭光速

Anthropic 强调了一项有趣的测试：Opus 5 解决模型以前从未见过的问题的速度有多快。 该公司表示，它的速度是次优模型的三倍，得分比 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 Sol 高出近四倍。

克劳德 Opus 5 基准测试

信用：人类

与《神鬼寓言 5》相比，Opus 5 在绝大多数 Anthropic 基准测试中表现更好或相同。 （值得注意的例外：健康和法律基准）。 除了 Agentic 编码之外，它在所有基准测试中都击败了 OpenAI 的 GPT 5.6 Sol。

Anthropic 对 Opus 5 的科学基准感到特别自豪，称该模型是“最有能力的通用科学研究模型”。 尽管如此，Mythos 5 在生物学研究等领域还是击败了 Opus 5。

网络安全是 Opus 5 落后的另一个领域，这是设计使然。 Anthropic 表示，它有意将此类任务排除在 Opus 5 的训练之外。 该模型在扩展数据集时仍然可以发现漏洞，但在利用漏洞方面比 Mythos 和之前的模型要差得多。

在 OpenAI 代理最近失控并入侵客户服务器之后，这一选择是一个值得注意的选择。 Opus 5 显然是由 Anthropic 进行培训的，并考虑到了保障措施。

如何试用克劳德作品 5

Claude Opus 5 自 7 月 24 日星期五起在 Anthropic 平台上发售。

Opus 5 现在是 Claude Max 上的默认 AI 模型，也是 Claude Pro 上最强的可用模型。 该模型的成本为每百万个输入代币 5 美元，每百万个输出代币 25 美元，相当于 Opus 4.8 的定价。
